```{r library, include=FALSE}
##### Load packages #####
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(microbiome)
library(randomcoloR)
metaphlan_profiles <- read_csv("count_table.csv") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
taxmat <- read_csv("tax_table.csv") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
metadata_table <- read_csv("metadata_table.csv") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "...1")


OTU2 = otu_table(as.matrix(metaphlan_profiles), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX2= tax_table(as.matrix(taxmat))
SAMPLE2 <- sample_data(metadata_table)
ps2 <- phyloseq(OTU2, TAX2,SAMPLE2)


colors_analysis = c("R" = "blue","NR"= "red", "D1" = "#F8766D",
                                                             "D2" ="#D89000",
                                                             "D5" ="#A3A500",
                                                             "D7" ="#39B600",
                                                             "D9" ="#00BF7D",
                                                             "D10" ="#00BFC4",
                                                             "D11" ="#00B0F6",
                                                             "D13" ="#9590FF",
                                                             "D14" ="#E76BF3",
                                                             "D15" ="#FF62BC",
                    "No" = "darkgreen", "Yes" = "purple","Melanoma" = "darkgreen", "NSCLC" = "purple",
                    "Donor" = "blueviolet","No G3 irAEs" = "darkgreen","G3 irAEs" = "blueviolet")

#####
```

# Fig.3A


```{r , message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=FALSE,fig.width=6, fig.height=5}




ps1.1_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps2))
ps1.1_count <- data.frame(otu_table(ps2))
taxa.rich<-specnumber(t(ps1.1_count))
#Shannon Index
taxa.shannon<- vegan::diversity(t(ps1.1_count), "shannon")
taxa.adiv<-data.frame(`#SampleID`=names(ps1.1_count),
                      RICHNESS=taxa.rich,
                      SHANNON=taxa.shannon, check.names = F)
rownames(taxa.adiv) <- gsub('\\.',"-",rownames(taxa.adiv))
ps1.1_meta<-merge(ps1.1_meta, taxa.adiv, by= 0) #, all=T
ps1.1_meta <- ps1.1_meta %>% column_to_rownames('Row.names')




```



```{r , message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=FALSE,fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

ggplot(ps1.1_meta[which(ps1.1_meta$fmt != "Donor"),], aes(x=time_point, y=RICHNESS, color=subject_id))+ 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle =0),
        text = element_text(size = 18),legend.position = 'right',legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)) + 
  xlab(NULL) + 
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE)+
  geom_line(aes(group = subject_id), size= 2) +scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("V2" = "Baseline", "V4" = "1 w", "V5" = "1 m", "V6" = "2 m", "V7" = "3 m", "V8" = "6 m", "V81" = "9 m" , "V9" = "1 y"))








```

  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle =0),
